meta.title: The MADFAM value ladder | Find your rung
meta.description: One ladder, many entry points. From a tool you buy in five minutes to a fractional CTO running your whole operation. Find the exact rung for you.

hero.eyebrow: The public front door of the ecosystem
hero.title: One ladder. Many doors. Climb at your own pace.
hero.subtitle: MADFAM isn't one product — it's an ecosystem arranged on a single ladder. At the bottom, a tool you buy self-serve in minutes. At the top, a fractional CTO running your whole operation. Enter anywhere and climb when you're ready.

doctrine.oneIdentity: One identity. You climb by adding entitlements, never by re-onboarding.
doctrine.worthMore: Every rung is worth more than its price — it replaces the tool it displaces.
doctrine.nothingLost: Nothing is lost by leaving: your data and access stay with you.

slice.name: A single tool
slice.tagline: One platform, one tier, self-serve in minutes.
slice.oneLine: When you need to solve just one thing: invoice, book, track your money.
slice.grants: Access to one platform and its tier — activated instantly on the same identity.
slice.valueVs: Versus a point tool: best-of-breed, MX-fiscal-native, and you're never locked in.
slice.priceNote: Each tool's price lives on its own product page. Pick one to see its tier and check out.

bundle.name: A capability bundle
bundle.tagline: Several curated tools for a whole job.
bundle.oneLine: When you have a whole workflow, not a single task.
bundle.grants: A set of platforms that already work together, bought in one step.
bundle.valueVs: Versus a generic suite: only the pieces your workflow needs, integrated, priced below the sum of the parts.

erp.name: Nauta ERP
erp.tagline: Your services behind one door, brand, and bill.
erp.oneLine: When you already run several tools and want to unify them under your brand.
erp.grants: All your entitled services behind one door, one identity, and one bill, under your brand.
erp.valueVs: Versus Zoho or Odoo: replaces the admin console with best-of-breed, MX-fiscal-native, ~20% below the incumbent.

vcto.name: Nauta vCTO
vcto.tagline: A fractional CTO runs your whole operation.
vcto.oneLine: When you want someone to run it for you, end to end.
vcto.grants: A fractional CTO plus the cockpit that runs your whole operation across the ecosystem. The top of the ladder.
vcto.valueVs: Versus a full-time hire: a fraction of a CTO's cost, to operate an entire ecosystem.

mx-fiscal.name: MX Fiscal
mx-fiscal.description: Your complete Mexican fiscal stack: CFDI with Karafiel and regulatory intelligence with Tezca.

design-to-sell.name: Design to Sell
design-to-sell.description: From idea to sale: parametric design with Yantra4D, pricing with Forgesight, and quoting with Cotiza.

erp-self-serve.name: Self-serve
erp-self-serve.description: For small teams unifying their tools behind one door.

erp-team.name: Team
erp-team.description: For growing teams that need more seats and control.

erp-biz.name: Business
erp-biz.description: For businesses running several platforms under their brand.

vcto-esencial.name: Essential
vcto-esencial.description: The entry point to the vCTO: fractional technical leadership for your operation.

vcto-ecosistema.name: Ecosystem
vcto-ecosistema.description: The market-validated rung: technical leadership that exercises the whole ecosystem.

vcto-escala.name: Scale
vcto-escala.description: For large-scale operations, quoted by scope.

ladder.title: The ladder, rung by rung
ladder.subtitle: Each rung shows what it is, what it grants, its benchmarked price, and who it competes with. Climb exactly as high as it serves you.

selector.title: Which rung is best for you?
selector.subtitle: Two quick questions and we recommend the smallest rung that does the job. The rung above is always an option, never a default.

needs.run-for-me: Have someone run it for me

proof.title: Why the ladder beats the monolith
proof.subtitle: The same anti-Zoho case, ecosystem-wide: best-of-breed, not a closed block.

fiscalNative.title: MX-fiscal-native
fiscalNative.description: CFDI, RFC, and SAT at the root, not a patch. Compliant by design, not after the fact.

salidaDigna.title: Guaranteed dignified exit
salidaDigna.description: Your data and access are yours. Export and drop a rung without losing anything.

vctoInBox.title: vCTO in the box
vctoInBox.description: Whenever you want, a fractional CTO runs it all for you. The top rung is always available.

bestOfBreed.title: Best-of-breed, not a monolith
bestOfBreed.description: Every piece is best at its job and works with the rest. You pick only what you need.

closing.title: Find your place on the ladder
closing.subtitle: Climb at your own pace self-serve, or bring in an advisor to walk it with you.
